fixtures.preview: Winless in nine and one point above the Premier League drop zone, United host Roma on Champions League matchday 4 (7am Wed 4 Nov Sydney).
talking_points: United have lost their last two Champions League games, to Atlético Madrid and Como (4-1), and have one win so far, over Sabah.
Saturday's 2-0 defeat at Chelsea, with Lisandro Martínez sent off, has raised doubts about Michael Carrick's future.
Roma beat Slovan Bratislava 4-0 last time out, and Donyell Malen already has three Champions League goals.
Bruno Fernandes and Bryan Mbeumo are the names tipped to lift United; no team news is confirmed yet.

fixtures.preview: Ninth-placed Villa (12 points) visit Old Trafford on Sunday at 4:30pm UK time (3:30am Mon 9 Nov Sydney).
The trip to Anfield is set for Sunday 22 November at 4:30pm UK time (3:30am Mon 23 Nov Sydney).
Matchday 5 in Lisbon, listed by UEFA at 21:00 CET (7am Thu 26 Nov Sydney).
Sixth-placed Brentford (14 points) visit on Saturday 28 November at 3pm UK time (2am Sun 29 Nov Sydney), United's first 3pm Saturday kick-off of the season.
Sydney look to bounce back at home on Friday night after losing their first game of the season at Melbourne City.
talking_points: Sydney lost 2-1 at Melbourne City after Al-Hassan Toure's 37th-minute opener, conceding in the 46th and 63rd minutes.
Coach Patrick Kisnorbo said 'we made two mistakes and that cost us', and a Toure goal was ruled offside before City's second.
Akol Akon started in place of Tiago Quintal against City; the line-up for Friday isn't confirmed.

fixtures.preview: An away trip to Brisbane Roar in matchweek 5, 6:40pm Brisbane time (7:40pm Sydney).
The Big Blue at Allianz Stadium on Sunday 6 December at 5pm.
An away game in Auckland in matchweek 8, listed at 5pm (treated here as New Zealand time).
A Friday-night home game against Perth Glory at Allianz Stadium.

notes: Search quality was poor again and many results were old seasons, so some sections are shorter than their limits rather than padded.

Man Utd: Saturday's 2-0 loss at Chelsea is confirmed by Sky Sports (Martínez sent off, winless nine). Roma talking points come from a Paramount+ preview; no team news is confirmed. The Brentford 3pm time comes from a fan-site report that the page blocked, so check manutd.com. Stan Sport is the Premier League and Champions League broadcaster in Australia.

Sydney FC: the Melbourne City result (2-1 loss) comes from the club's report. I couldn't find the matchweek 6 fixture (around 27–29 Nov), so one match may be missing between Brisbane and Melbourne Victory. Paramount+ streams every A-League game, but per-match broadcasters were not listed. The Auckland kick-off is treated as New Zealand time.

Big matches: Champions League times were re-checked on UEFA's list; Wallabies, Socceroos and Rugby broadcasters are carried from earlier checks. Liverpool v Arsenal (1 Nov) was dropped as it has been played, and table points were as of Saturday night.

Live sport: no Sydney tennis, rugby union, Matildas or Socceroos games were found for the next four weeks. A Sydney Kings home game on 8 Nov appears on third-party listings, but the NBL page only lists 15 Nov, so it was left out.

Arts: Beetlejuice and Whispering Jack details come from search results because the venue pages couldn't be opened. Foo Fighters, Robbie Williams (times TBC) and the Enmore shows are from official pages; Northlane (11 Nov) is postponed.

Local: school events come from the downloaded Term 4 calendars and Week 3 Principal Updates (all read). Nothing was found for the second school. No local news from the last 7 days was found beyond the debating item; South Eveleigh November events weren't found.

Not found: Sydney matcha pop-ups in November, kids' fun runs or junior parkrun, Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events, children's author talks with confirmed dates, football-boot sales and kids' sport events, so the section for the son is empty. Woolworths and Coles half-price lists for the 4 Nov week weren't available; groceries come from catalogue sites (28 Oct to 3 Nov, plus Aldi's 4 Nov specials).

Dropped this run: events that have finished (Sydney Open, Ghost Festival, Halloween events, Le Marché, jewellery workshop, Betty's Burgers) and the Paddy Pallin sale, Hockey One game, parkrun item, Football Manager and gift-card deals, which couldn't be re-verified.
